Innovation and Commercialisation

Innovation and
Commercialisation

 

Accelerate the growth and success of your business with Innovation and commercialisation facilities at the University of Warwick. We offer a range of opportunities to support businesses and entrepreneurs with developing innovative ideas into successful ventures.

Get in touch

Warwick Innovation District

Our collaborative platforms and ecosystems leverage Warwick's pioneering research facilities and business partnerships, providing a space for academics, entrepreneurs, and investors to start, scale, and pivot businesses in a rapidly changing world.
 
Warwick Innovation District

Innovation Campus, Stratford-upon-Avon

A world-class research and development hub for agritech, environmental technology, and advanced engineering. Businesses, academics and investors can accelerate innovation and commercialisation utilising state-of-the-art facilities and expertise.

Innovation Campus

Warwick Innovations

Supporting Warwick’s researchers with commercialising their research and innovation. Offering expertise in IP, commercialisation and enterprise, and providing access to funding, incubation, acceleration and networking opportunities, Warwick Innovations helps to transform ideas into successful businesses.

Warwick Innovations

University of Warwick Science Park

Providing cutting-edge facilities and expert support to innovative businesses. Flexible workspaces, business acceleration services and network of industry connections are designed to help businesses grow and thrive.
 
University of Warwick

Minerva Business Angel Network

A group of angel investors, entrepreneurs and business professionals who provide investment, mentorship and support to high-growth businesses. Minerva connects investors with innovative startups and scaleups across various sectors, providing access to funding, expertise and networks.
 
Minerva Business Angel Network

Spin Outs

Explore our successful spinouts to-date.
 
Spin Outs

Health Innovation @ Warwick

The University is committed to forming regional, national and international partnerships to drive innovation in health care for public and patient benefit. We are forming health missions in priority areas for partners to join and we are leading on the development of a new Health Tech campus at Arden Cross.
